text: You get stuck in a broken elevator. Within 90 seconds, you have started a cult and named yourself Supreme Leader.
When someone cancels plans, your soul leaves your body in pure happiness like a Victorian ghost.
You see a quiet person sitting alone at a party and decide, 'Congrats, you are my hostage bestie now.'
You would rather fight a raccoon in a dark alley than say 'So, what do you do for work?' at a party.
If nobody talks to you for three hours, you poke yourself in the mirror to make sure you still exist.
You accidentally make eye contact with a stranger on the street and immediately feel forced to start a full conversation.
Your social battery dies so fast that even texting 'haha yeah' feels like running a marathon.
You treat every cashier, delivery driver, and random dog walker like they are co-hosts on your personal talk show.
Being invited to a surprise party is your actual worst nightmare, right above falling into a volcano.
You get bored so easily alone in your room that you start arguing with your own reflection just for drama.
You love your friends deeply, mostly from a safe distance of at least three miles and behind a locked door.
You can turn a 10-second elevator ride into a lifelong friendship before the doors even open.
After hanging out with people for two hours, you need to lie face-down on the floor in a dark room to recharge.
Silence in a group makes you so uncomfortable that you will say the weirdest thing alive just to fill the air.
Your dream weekend is turning your phone on airplane mode and pretending civilization collapsed.
While eating cereal, you accidentally invent a theory about how pigeons are secret government spies.
When someone says 'Follow your dreams,' you ask, 'Okay, does my dream have dental insurance and free parking?'
You have a 10-step plan to fight a bear, even though you get scared when the toaster pops up.
You don't care about 'vibes.' If you can't lick it, poke it, or weigh it, it's fake.
You zone out so hard staring at a spoon that you miss your bus stop, your birthday, and possibly a small war.
You randomly wonder what colors look like to a crab instead of paying attention to what someone is saying to you.
When someone tells you a crazy dream they had, you immediately check out because none of it happened in real life.
You connect two totally random things—like burnt toast and ancient Rome—and somehow make it sound deep.
You actually read the instruction manual before building furniture instead of guessing and crying later.
You spend half your day living in fake scenarios inside your head that will never happen.
You notice immediately when someone gets a tiny haircut or moves a lamp two inches to the left.
You love weird 'what if' questions, like 'What if chairs had kneecaps?'
If a recipe says 'add a pinch of salt,' you get mad because you want exact grams and measurements.
A baby pigeon falls over. Instead of feeling bad, you think, 'Skill issue, honestly.'
You accidentally drop a sock on the floor and feel guilty because now it's separated from its twin brother.
When a friend cries about a bad haircut, you calmly pull out a ruler to measure how uneven it really is.
If a cloud looks vaguely like a sad puppy, you need to lie down on the floor and cry for ten minutes.
You cheer for the movie villain because at least they had a calendar and a working PowerPoint presentation.
When someone tells you a sad story, your brain automatically tries to fix their problem instead of just giving a hug.
You feel bad throwing away an ugly stuffed toy because you think it will feel abandoned in the trash.
You would rather be brutally honest and start a tiny fire than tell a white lie to keep the peace.
If someone uses a slightly sharp tone with you, you replay that conversation in your head for the next six years.
In horror movies, you get mad at the characters for making dumb decisions instead of feeling scared for them.
You can tell the exact second someone's mood shifts in a room, even if they are smiling.
You treat every minor disagreement like a courtroom trial where you brought receipts and witnesses.
You cry at wholesome commercials about grandpas eating soup.
If a rule makes zero logical sense, you break it out of pure disrespect.
You write 'Make a to-do list' on your to-do list just so you can cross it off and feel godlike.
Your life plan is just a sticky note that says 'idk lol' taped to a burning dumpster.
If someone arrives 4 minutes late, you silently put a tiny curse on their bloodline.
You don't start working until the panic monster kicks down your door at 3:14 AM.
Before taking a relaxing nap, you set three alarms and rank your dreams by priority.
You pack your bags three days before a trip and check your passport fourteen times.
You pack your bags 15 minutes before leaving and just throw random clothes into a tote bag like a raccoon.
Seeing an unorganized desktop with 200 random files gives you physical chest pain.
Your room looks like a tornado hit it, yet you know the exact pile where your missing charger is buried.
You hate surprises unless you were secretly the one who planned the surprise.
